title: 年賀状じまい・ごあいさつ
subject_en: Gentle thank-you and farewell-greeting motifs for retiring from New Year cards, each a separate object, simple flat style in calm pastel colours. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 年賀状じまいの挨拶状やシールに添える、感謝の小さなイラスト12点。やさしい色のフラットなタッチで、押しつけがましくない仕上がりです。
items: a letter with an envelope tied by a thin ribbon
a fountain pen with an ink bottle
a postage stamp with a simple flower design and a wavy postmark circle
a tea cup and a small teapot
two hands holding a small heart
a simple bowing person seen from the side, faceless
a single flower in a small vase
a calm sunset over a small hill
a small bird sitting on a branch
a blank card with a ribbon
